symbols.name: edge rank
symbols.meaning: The rank of one edge matrix, which is summed over all edges to give the total number of smaller calls.
symbols.quote: Write $a$ for the rank of one edge matrix.

symbols.name: smaller call count
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls, counted as the sum of the edge ranks over all edges.
symbols.quote: Summing $a$ over all edges gives the total number of smaller calls, $s$.

relations.quote: Rank-saving recursion is a recursive scheme that runs on a [linear network](linear-network.md).
The recursion is stated in the [frame of a vertex](frame.md) at each end of an edge, where the frame is the invertible linear operator that fixes how the array on that vertex's wires is stored.
The recursion splits its array into [role streams from a cyclic row split](role-streams.md) across the $W$ roles, the fixed wire places of the network.
The cost is measured by [nested subspace labels](subspace-labels.md) on the edges.
